test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly visited the Magento admin category listing (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_category/). To reproduce the successful run, select the common admin node 'Default Category', add a subcategory named 'New Subcategory from Test' and set its URL key to 'new-subcategory-test'. The example sets the category active ('1'), included in menu ('1'), display mode to 'Products only', and edits under 'All Store Views'. create_root_category is false because the execution targeted an existing category node rather than adding a root category.
